title: ZEUS Billing FAQ
content:
ZEUS Billing FAQ · Page 1
Section 1: Invoices and credits
Q: When is an invoice due? A: Within 30 calendar days after receipt, unless the signed order states another term. Q: Where can I find a credit? A: Credits appear as a separate line on the next invoice. Q: Who can request a billing correction? A: The account billing contact. Supplier terms in zeus-supplier-agreement-template, Section 1, apply only when that agreement is signed.
